name: Security Budget Breaker and Kill Switch
mechanism: Enforces external step, time, token, cost, fan-out, retry and delegation limits and can revoke credentials and stop execution independent of model cooperation.
use_when: Agent loops can retry delegate or execute costly actions
avoid_when: The breaker cannot terminate workers or revoke downstream authority
Limits are embedded only in the system prompt
expected_effects: Contained cascading failures and resource abuse
failure_modes: Breaker state is unavailable during incident
